trap-nonspeakable.notes: THREE MATH FINDINGS to report (none edited). (1) Degree mismatch in the displayed commutator: [d, pi_V] alpha = L_xi(alpha) - pi_V(L_xi(alpha)) = pi_H(L_xi alpha) cannot hold, since d raises form degree by one and pi_V preserves it, so the left side has degree deg(alpha)+1 while the right side has degree deg(alpha). (2) omega_V = d(pi_V(d 1_A)) is identically zero: in any first-order differential calculus d(1_A) = 0 (from d(1.1) = 2 d1), so pi_V(d 1_A) = 0 and omega_V = 0 - which would make prop:categorical-dq-squared's right-hand side vanish for every alpha, contradicting the proposition. Whatever 2-form is intended, this is not a well-formed definition of it. (3) The middle term is over-stated rather than wrong: (pi_V d) o d = pi_V o d^2 = 0 by the same d^2 = 0 already invoked, so ab(d(pi_V d alpha) + pi_V d(d alpha)) reduces to ab d(pi_V d alpha) and the second summand can be dropped. Checked and correct: the binomial expansion is right, and the coefficient ab = q^{-1}(1 - q^{-1}) matches the proposition's stated prefactor exactly. The align* is correctly fenced as an outer environment inside a tex fence (render-math-mode-envelope satisfied).
